what: Each image in the card grid is covered by a frosted film (backdrop-filter blurring what is behind by 14px + light gray 8%). Once 12% of a card is on screen, the film lifts after a random 80~680ms delay over .85s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1). Hovering one card keeps only that card clear while its image grows 1.035× (.55s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.4,1)). The other cards frost over again and their text fades to .45. On leave, everything clears again.

options.--fx-dim: Opacity of the remaining card text, default .45
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Picture area inside the card — frost forms over this (inner img and video scale up)
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Text inside card (optional) — fades when another card is hovered

from.where: news.html .nw-item (journal card grid) · detail.html .dt-more__item (two other-work slots, 1200px and up)
